task_completion.description: Open the starter file wedding_venue_starter.sh3d in Sweet Home 3D.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Sweet Home 3D interface is visible showing the initial villa floor plan layout.

task_completion.description: Create and label four distinct functional zones: Grand Dining, Dance Floor, Head Table, and Bar & Lounge.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text labels or room names for 'Grand Dining', 'Dance Floor', 'Head Table', and 'Bar & Lounge' are visible in the 2D plan or 3D view.

task_completion.description: Visually differentiate at least three zones using distinct floor colors or textures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least three separate floor areas show different colors or patterns (e.g., wood for dance floor, carpet for dining) in the 3D rendering or 2D plan.

task_completion.description: Place at least 8 dining tables and 32 chairs in Grand Dining, and 1 table with 4 chairs for the Head Table.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A large cluster of tables and chairs (8+ tables, 32+ chairs) and a separate smaller arrangement (1 table, 4 chairs) are visible.

task_completion.description: Place 2 tables/counters and 1 sofa in the Bar & Lounge area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A sofa and two counter-height surfaces or small tables are visible in the designated Bar & Lounge zone.

task_completion.description: Add at least 6 light fixtures and 4 plants to the space.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least 6 lamps/ceiling lights and 4 potted plant models are distributed throughout the venue.

task_completion.description: Save the completed project to wedding_venue_final.sh3d.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog or the window title bar shows the filename 'wedding_venue_final.sh3d'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and change textures.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, or the 'Modify Room' dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply use command line scripts to generate the .sh3d file without opening the app.
integrity.visual_evidence: The progression of the layout is visible across multiple screenshots of the Sweet Home 3D application window.

integrity.description: The furniture and zones are manually arranged rather than appearing instantly in a finished state.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the incremental addition of furniture and the adjustment of floor textures.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific counts: 8+ dining tables and 32+ chairs in 'Grand Dining'; 1 table and 4 chairs in 'Head Table'; 2 tables/counters and 1 sofa in 'Bar & Lounge'; 6+ lights and 4+ plants total. Floor differentiation must be done via textures/colors, not walls. The final file must be saved as wedding_venue_final.sh3d. The pass threshold is 70/100.
